messages.subject: For Ammar Al-Joundi | Responsible growth, community partnerships and country execution
messages.body:
Dear Agnico Eagle Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ammar Al-Joundi, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Agnico Eagle's growth model depends on maintaining strong relationships with communities, governments and long-term partners as major assets and development projects advance. The same discipline that protects operating performance also protects social licence, trust and long-term optionality.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, community engagement, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around large-scale renewable-energy infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a senior conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Agnico Eagle's responsible growth, stakeholder strategy, community relations or country-facing leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
